headline: Claude ecosystem expands with developer tools addressing workflow bottlenecks
body: A cluster of community-built applications around Claude emerged this week, including Coffeetable for information discovery, MulmoTerminal for managing multiple code sessions, GitMir for development debugging, and usage tracking tools. These utilities signal developers are building operational infrastructure around Claude to solve friction points in real-world deployment. For healthcare AI specifically, the rise of Claude-native tools suggests the vendor ecosystem is maturing to support the integration patterns needed for clinical documentation, code review in EHR customization, and distributed computing scenarios where local inference (like Yeschef's Ollama integration) manages compliance concerns. Consulting teams should monitor which of these tools healthcare institutions adopt, as they indicate where Claude implementation gaps exist and where custom tooling may be necessary for regulated environments.
